user.title: MVM Tariff
user.description: Where should consumption data come from?

mqtt.title: MQTT (P1 meter registers)
mqtt.description: Set your P1 meter's MQTT root topic (the jantenhove/esp8266_p1meter project publishes under "sensors/power/p1meter" by default).

power_sensors.title: Power sensors
power_sensors.description: Pick an existing HA sensor reporting instantaneous import power, and optionally one for export power (both in kW). The integration turns these into hourly kWh (trapezoidal integration); import minus export is the net consumption. You can also give the meter's own cumulative kWh totals (e.g. "P1 Active Energy Import/Export Total") - read once at startup so the consumption sensor starts from the real meter reading instead of zero.

data_source.title: Data source
data_source.description: MQTT: the P1 meter's two tariff registers (Wh), in the jantenhove/esp8266_p1meter topic format. Power sensors: an existing HA import (and optionally export) power sensor (kW) is integrated into hourly kWh; import minus export is the net consumption. Only the fields for the chosen data source matter.

pricing.title: A1 tariff
pricing.description: Tiered household tariff: reduced price up to the allowance, market price above it. The allowance can be accounted MONTHLY (~210 kWh/month, as invoiced) or YEARLY (2523 kWh from 1 January).

data.price_high: Market price above the allowance (HUF/kWh, gross)

d_tariff.title: "D" (dynamic) tariff
d_tariff.description: The "D" tariff keeps the same allowance: up to it, the A1 price; only the overage is priced at the 15-minute HUPX market price. Prices are downloaded from the internet (api.energy-charts.info, and - if the rate is 0 - the MNB daily EUR/HUF rate); this is the only place the integration uses the network. The fees are estimates and freely editable.

data.d_eur_huf: EUR/HUF rate (0 = MNB daily rate, fetched automatically)
